categories.A: Existing generic primitive with no School-specific lifecycle engine required.
categories.B: Existing primitive plus a thin School adapter for vocabulary, resource scoping, policy or projection.
categories.C: Reusable new platform primitive required before the School workflow should be built.
categories.D: Genuinely School-specific domain capability; keep inside the School vertical.

cDecision: No category-C primitive is required for the representative scope. D5 workflow/consent/audit primitives closed the lifecycle gap identified in D0; D4 policy and D6 API boundaries cover the remaining cross-cutting mechanics.

workflows.label: Student / guardian relationships
workflows.schoolAdapter: School relationship vocabulary plus guardian-to-student resource policy.
workflows.rationale: The graph and authorization mechanics are generic; guardian semantics are School-owned.

workflows.label: Class / teacher scoping
workflows.schoolAdapter: Map class/cohort membership and teacher responsibility into scoped policy relationships.
workflows.rationale: Class scope is a domain vocabulary over existing group/affiliation/policy mechanics.

workflows.label: Notices and required actions
workflows.schoolAdapter: Resolve class/student/guardian audience and project required actions into D5 workflow items.
workflows.rationale: Publishing and action mechanics already exist; only audience semantics are School-specific.

workflows.label: Field-trip / activity consent
workflows.schoolAdapter: Bind guardian, student and trip resource; define purpose and expiry.
workflows.rationale: Consent is already generic and purpose/resource/time scoped.

workflows.label: Absence recovery and missed-work follow-through
workflows.schoolAdapter: Project an attendance/absence source record into recovery tasks for the affected student/guardian/teacher.
workflows.rationale: Recovery is a generic obligation lifecycle; only the attendance source is School-specific.

workflows.label: Homework and tasks
workflows.schoolAdapter: Translate class/student assignment semantics into WorkflowItem projections and scoped reads.
workflows.rationale: Task lifecycle already exists; School owns the learning semantics and content.

workflows.label: Parent-teacher meeting continuity
workflows.schoolAdapter: Project PTM slots, attendance and follow-up actions without creating a parallel workflow engine.
workflows.rationale: Event and follow-up mechanics are generic; meeting semantics and sensitive notes stay School-owned.

workflows.label: School events and RSVP
workflows.schoolAdapter: None required for the basic lifecycle; School may supply labels/audience filters.
workflows.rationale: The existing shared event lifecycle already supports create/list/respond semantics.

workflows.label: Parent concerns / follow-through
workflows.schoolAdapter: School-owned concern record projected into the same D5 obligation mechanics used by Housing complaints.
workflows.rationale: Complaint/concern follow-through mechanics are reusable; School must not reuse Housing persistence or vocabulary.

workflows.label: Student journey history
workflows.schoolAdapter: Compose authorized student-scoped milestones and activity projections; do not expose a network-wide timeline by default.
workflows.rationale: Timeline ingredients exist; School defines milestone meaning and visibility.

workflows.label: Attendance recording
workflows.schoolAdapter: School-owned attendance state, reason vocabulary and correction rules.
workflows.rationale: Attendance has genuinely School-specific record semantics even though authorization and command mechanics are shared.

workflows.label: Transport and authorized pickup
workflows.schoolAdapter: School-owned route, stop, vehicle/pickup authorization and release semantics.
workflows.rationale: Transport/pickup safety semantics are domain-specific; keep them thin but School-owned.
